<!-- Release notes generated using configuration in .github/release.yml at 1.55.0 -->

## What's Changed
### Breaking Changes 🛠
* Add deprecation warning to SnowparkConnection by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/14125
### New Features 🎉
* Extend sprintf to support thousand separator by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/13284
* Refactor `SettingsDialog` & add copyable version by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/13791
* Exclude collapsed expander content from browser find-in-page (Cmd+F) by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/13818
* Allow dynamic changes to `st.pills` and `st.segmented_control` options when key is provided by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/13684
* Add support for cachetools 7.x by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/13839
* Add support for selections on multi-view vega charts by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/13591
* Add `client.allowedOrigins` config option by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/13829
* Have server ack app_heartbeat messages received from client by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/13810
* feat: add metricValueFontSize and metricValueFontWeight theme options by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/13550
* [feature] add width auto parameter to st.markdown by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/13841
* Bind widgets to query params - FE hooks & `color_picker` support by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/13845
* Bind widgets to query params - `st.checkbox` & `st.toggle` by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/13900
* Auto-escape some markdown syntax in markdown labels by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/13887
* Bind widgets to query params - `st.text_input` & `st.text_area` by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/13901
* Add page visibility parameter to `st.Page` by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/13905
* Add `width` and `height` configuration to `st.table` by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/13850
* Bind widgets to query params - `st.radio` & `st.selectbox` by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/13922
* Bind widgets to query params - `st.number_input` by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/13917
* Bind widgets to query params - `st.multiselect` by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/13951
* [DynamicContainers] Dynamic Popovers by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/13914
* Add select all and select x matches (select all 2) by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/13795
* New styling for selectbox and multiselect (select all 3) by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/13796
* New styling for date and time widgets (select all 4) by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/13797
* New styling for remaining dropdowns (select all 5) by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/13798
* Add `delta_description` to `st.metric` by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/13848
* [DynamicContainers] Dynamic Tabs by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/13910
* [feat] Add scroll arrows for overflowing tabs in `st.tabs` by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/13987
* [DynamicContainers] Dynamic Expanders by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/13888
* Bind widgets to query params - `st.slider` & `st.select_slider` by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/13979
* [feat] Add custom hex color support for markdown rendering by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/14041
* [feat] Add markdown support to page titles in `st.Page` by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/14010
* Bind widgets to query params - `st.pills` & `st.segmented_control` by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/14006
* Bind widgets to query params - `st.date_input` by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/14034
* [DynamicContainers] Callback support for expanders by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/14008
* [Feat] Updated `MainMenu` by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/14101
* Add logger.hideWelcomeMessage config option by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/14118
* Bind widgets to query params - `st.datetime_input` & `st.time_input` by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/14103
* [DynamicContainers] Callback support for popovers by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/14075
* [DynamicContainers] Callback support for tabs by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/14007
* [feature] Add `link` parameter to `st.image` by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/14139
* [feat] Add markdown support for navigation section headers by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/14053
### Bug Fixes 🐛
* [security] Prevent SSRF attacks via path traversal in component file handling by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/13733
* [fix] Support boolean values for client.showErrorLinks config option by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/13806
* Fix `st.select_slider` `format_func` regression in AppTest by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/13837
* Initialize all columns when appending rows to `data_editor` by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/13916
* Don't accept 0 max selections in `st.multiselect` by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/13966
* [fix] Restore layered vconcat width propagation and add #13974 regression tests by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/13980
* [fix] Add selection support for treemap and sunburst in `st.plotly_chart` by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/13935
* fix: preserve active tab selection after spinner reruns by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/14023
* fix(code-block): move copy action into toolbar and preserve keyboard accessibility by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/14024
* Fix st.Page accepting slash-only url_path without raising exception by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/14005
* fix(vega-lite): render vconcat charts with faceted/repeated children by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/14065
* fix(widgets): clear stale date validation UI on form clear by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/14066
* fix(button-group): keep segmented control hover borders visually consistent by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/14067
* Cache SqlConnection.query results per-instance. by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/14094
* [fix] st.metric with chart_data wrapping in horizontal containers by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/14110
* [fix] Normalize all `date_input` session state values to date by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/14123
* Fix spinner clear_transient race condition during rapid reruns by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/13849
### Other Changes
* Improve `streamlit config show` output for theme sourcing by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/13761
* [chore] Update emojis/material icons by [USER][bot] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/13789
* [chore] Release v1.54.0 by [USER][bot] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/13807
* [refactor] remove loading skeleton for dynamic popover by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/14043
* [chore] Update emojis/material icons by [USER][bot] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/14099
* Improve version copy accessibility by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/14131
* [chore] Wire up check_widget_policies correctly in dynamic containers by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/14143
* Format date/time slider URL query params as ISO strings by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/14120

## New Contributors
* [USER] made their first contribution in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/14005

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/compare/1.54.0...1.55.0
